body: After Web IDL conversion a dictionary is an ordered map with no record of which dictionary type it came from, so this test has no defined answer. It is also redundant, because `SetHTMLOptions` and `ParseHTMLUnsafeOptions` have no `runScripts` member, so `options["runScripts"]` with default false already yields false for them. The switch can be just `TrustedParserOptions` and otherwise `options["runScripts"]` with default false.
